prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Aussiedlerhof", a small settler homestead farm in the rust-red desert wasteland outside the cyberpunk city, seen from above. One large walkable area: a wide open farmyard of packed, sun-baked ochre earth and dusty sand with tire tracks and a few footpaths, filling most of the image, flat, bright and uncluttered in the middle.
TOP EDGE: a low fence of scrap metal posts and wire with a wide wooden farm gate standing open at the top center; outside it rust-red desert and a dirt track leading north.
TOP LEFT: the farm shop - a small adobe mud-brick building with a corrugated-metal roof and a striped canvas awning over an open counter, crates of vegetables, honey jars, sacks and water filters on shelves, a chalk board with only drawings of a carrot and a bee (no letters).
TOP RIGHT: a row of big triangular solar sails and solar panels on scaffolding poles, cables running down to a battery box.
LEFT SIDE: an old rounded silver travel caravan with seashells glued all around its windows and a little pin board with paper notes on its side, in front of it a wooden veranda deck with a faded awning, a hammock, a camping chair and a lantern; a washing line with colourful laundry stretched between two poles nearby.
CENTER: a round stone well with an old iron hand pump and a bucket, a wet dark patch of sand around it - the most eye-catching spot.
RIGHT SIDE: a corrugated-iron and adobe workshop shed with a wide open roll-up door, a workbench with tools, gears, a vice, an old radio and spare robot parts inside; in front of it a weathered wooden bench.
BOTTOM LEFT: several long raised vegetable beds with lush green plants under shade nets on poles.
BOTTOM CENTER: an empty rectangular plot of freshly turned dark soil framed by planks, a watering can and a hoe beside it.
BOTTOM RIGHT OF CENTER: a campfire ring of stones with log benches around it; BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER: a small flower garden corner with colourful blooming flowers and a little trellis.
Small props at the edges: a boxy goat-shaped farm robot (unoccupied, standing still, a machine not an animal), water barrels, a wheelbarrow, wind chimes made of glass shards, crates, a rusty scooter.
RIGHT EDGE: a long wire fence beyond which glittering glass dunes begin. BOTTOM EDGE: dry scrub and desert sand.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north), center - the open farm gate with a dirt track leading away into the desert toward a dusty road.
Light and material: no neon here, warm dusty orange desert daylight, clay, sand, sun-bleached wood, rusty corrugated metal, green plants as accent; some warm yellow lantern light on the veranda.
Time: late afternoon, clear sky, long soft shadows.
